title: Array loops
description:
Every function gets an array of signed 8-byte numbers in `rdi` and its count in `rsi`:

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `sum(array, n)` | the total (0 for an empty array) |
| `max_of(array, n)` | the largest, n >= 1 |
| `count_equal(array, n, v)` | how many elements equal v |
| `index_of(array, n, v)` | the first index holding v, or −1 |
| `reverse(array, n)` | reverses the array in place |
| `add_to_all(array, n, k)` | adds k to every element in place |

starter.solution.asm:
sum:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

max_of:
        mov     rax, [rdi]
        ret

count_equal:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

index_of:
        mov     rax, -1
        ret

reverse:
        ret

add_to_all:
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
sum:
        xor     eax, eax
        xor     ecx, ecx
.loop:  cmp     rcx, rsi
        jae     .done
        add     rax, [rdi + rcx*8]
        inc     rcx
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

max_of:
        mov     rax, [rdi]
        mov     ecx, 1
.loop:  cmp     rcx, rsi
        jae     .done
        mov     rdx, [rdi + rcx*8]
        cmp     rdx, rax
        cmovg   rax, rdx
        inc     rcx
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

count_equal:
        xor     eax, eax
        xor     ecx, ecx
.loop:  cmp     rcx, rsi
        jae     .done
        cmp     [rdi + rcx*8], rdx
        jne     .next
        inc     rax
.next:  inc     rcx
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

index_of:
        xor     eax, eax
.loop:  cmp     rax, rsi
        jae     .none
        cmp     [rdi + rax*8], rdx
        je      .done
        inc     rax
        jmp     .loop
.none:  mov     rax, -1
.done:  ret

reverse:
        test    rsi, rsi
        jz      .done
        lea     rdx, [rdi + rsi*8 - 8]  ; the last element
.loop:  cmp     rdi, rdx
        jae     .done
        mov     rax, [rdi]
        mov     rcx, [rdx]
        mov     [rdi], rcx
        mov     [rdx], rax
        add     rdi, 8
        sub     rdx, 8
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

add_to_all:
        xor     ecx, ecx
.loop:  cmp     rcx, rsi
        jae     .done
        add     [rdi + rcx*8], rdx
        inc     rcx
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

hints: Use `rcx` as the index from 0 to n and read `[rdi + rcx*8]` each time round; check `rcx < rsi` at the top so an empty array is handled.
For `reverse`, use two indexes, one from each end, swap the two elements, and move them towards each other until they meet.
